purpose: K-WIDEN retrieval-width mini-campaign on DEV-100 (owner iterate-before-concluding discipline; DEV-500 confirmatory verdict section 4.1 gate: k-widening top-k 8-32 may be dev-iterated on DEV-100/500 under a new registered mini-campaign BEFORE the DEV-1000 touch). Evidence basis: the DEV-500 retrieval-reachability curve at the frozen cell -- gold-facet recall 71.50 percent at k=5, 74.25 percent at k=8, 84.25 percent at k=32 -- shows BLEND operates AT the k=5 ceiling, so wider recall is the only quantified headroom outside key construction. The DEV-100 damage-channel analysis proved raising recall_top_k_per_dimension ALONE is a no-op (the fuser's top_m=5 re-truncates the wider pool before admission; 0 of 100 trajectories change), so each round moves recall_top_k_per_dimension AND fusion_m TOGETHER as ONE registered coupled variable named retrieval width. Every other knob is byte-frozen from configs/policy/kb-policy-v1-dev100.json (the sealed DEV-100 campaign's frozen cell: alpha 0.45, tau 0.65, rrf rank weighting 0.5/0.3/0.2, fusion_c 2, fusion_top_l 3, train priors, f1060078 label-identity repair, M11 pair-boundary stage OFF, value vectors SEALED, facet-side percept admission). Gold opens scoring-side only after a round's arms seal, never in runtime. This fragment is the machine-readable mini-campaign contract: knob ladder, arms, stopping rule, ceilings, comparison spec, and the pinned knowledge snapshot. It carries no promotion claim -- any widened cell that wins on DEV-100 gets its own DEV-500-tier confirmatory registration later, per the ladder.

kb_campaign_authority.gate: docs/readiness/2026-08-24-dev500-confirmatory-verdict.md section 4.1 (DEV-1000 gate: k-widening dev-iteration on DEV-100/500 first, under a new registered mini-campaign, per iterate-before-concluding)
kb_campaign_authority.design_input: docs/readiness/2026-08-24-dev100-damage-channel-analysis.md (top_m re-truncation lesson sections 6-7: top_k 8 alone changes 0 trajectories; top_k 8 + m 8 changes the supply on 34 of 100 round-2-basis trajectories with outcomes unknowable offline; gold newly supplied on 1 of the 11 damage samples)
kb_campaign_authority.frozen_cell: configs/policy/kb-policy-v1-dev100.json (byte-frozen non-width knobs; the DEV-100 campaign verdict froze this cell at 72/100 with zero C-to-W)

kb_campaign_policy_chain.m11_pair_boundary_rationale: carried frozen from the sealed DEV-100 campaign cell; not a KWIDEN variable

kb_campaign_round_k1_knobs.derivation: the frozen kb-policy-v1-dev100.json cell with EXACTLY the coupled retrieval-width move top_k 5 to 8 AND fusion_m 5 to 8 (one registered variable; the damage analysis proved m must widen with k or the move is inert). c and top_l unchanged, so the supplied-value ceiling stays c*top_l = 6 and the retain-primary mechanism (retain fires if and only if the repaired normalizer recovers a direct label, alpha 0.45 dominance) is m-invariant.

kb_campaign_tunable_knobs: retrieval_width (recall_top_k_per_dimension AND fusion_m, moved together as ONE registered coupled variable per round; all other knobs byte-frozen from configs/policy/kb-policy-v1-dev100.json)

kb_campaign_arms.description: direct decode baseline, CONSUMED from the sealed DEV-100 round-0 per-sample scoring artifact (48/100); never re-flown under this campaign

C3 alpha-blend at the widened retrieval cell: direct decode, then acquire, then evidence-conditioned decode on dispatched trajectories only (retain-primary trajectories stop at 1 contact); every contact carries the original speech packet

kb_campaign_comparison_spec.primary: paired per-sample vs the sealed DEV-100 BLEND round-4 and round-5 artifacts (both 72/100, C-to-W 0, retain-primary 63-67) and vs the sealed round-0 M0 (48/100)
deliverables: W-to-C and C-to-W lists vs M0 and vs round-4/round-5
retain-primary rate and its equality with direct-label-recovered (the alpha 0.45 mechanism invariant)
supply-change attribution on dispatched trajectories (which samples' selected_value_ids changed vs the round-4/5 width-5 cell)
evidence-prompt declared-token distribution vs round-5's (median 2404, max 2928)
decode rates, prompt-reuse ratios, canary and resend byte identity

widened.condition: net paired gain vs the round-4/5 base (delta correct samples > 0) with C-to-W vs M0 not exceeding the base's 0 by more than the gain
widened.consequence: the coordinator may register the next ladder width (16 then 32) as the following round

converged_or_falsified.condition: delta vs the round-4/5 base <= 0, or losses on previously-correct dispatched samples offset the reachability gains
converged_or_falsified.consequence: widening is declared exhausted at this tier; the mini-campaign ends and the report recommends key-construction work instead

kb_campaign_stopping_rule.evaluation_moment: between rounds only, after every arm of a round has completed (runner seal-before-score); gold never enters runtime

kb_campaign_ceilings.one_shot_semantics: per ROUND attempt; no silent intra-round retry. The campaign exposure row stays open across rounds K1..K3 with per-round accounting appended until the stopping rule fires or the hard cap is reached.

kb_campaign_per_round_discipline.resend_rationale: the pcorrf divergence lesson: each round records the server -np and one byte-identical prompt resend pair.
kb_campaign_per_round_discipline.prompt_fit_precondition: a session-bound prompt-fit MF row at the round's fusion_m worst case (m longest facet representations + 6 longest values, conservative) must PASS before takeoff; the round-5 evidence prompts measured declared max 2928 at m=5 against the 8192-token slot
outputs: wrong-to-correct and correct-to-wrong lists vs M0 and vs the round-4/5 base
